name: Hazard Yard
design_intent:
HAZARD YARD — the PROOF level for the two new LETHAL gimmicks: the crusher (v6_party_gimmicks_circuits.md §2.2) and falling_debris (§2.3), built on the SAME lethal-contact plumbing the spinning_hammer established (Area2D on LAYER_HAZARDS -> kill(&ring_out) — NOT a shove; deterministic phase clock; self-rendering telegraphy). A symmetric industrial three-island arena over ONE full-width lethal void (the flagship shape, mirroring hammer_arena): island A (refuge/spawns), island B (the CRUSHER lane), island C (the FALLING-DEBRIS zone). Kill identity stays 'get knocked/splatted off into the void': dodge-or-die the hazards, fight rivals on the islands, and the money play is to KNOCK a rival into the crusher / under a chunk (credited to you via the 6s ring-out window) or off an island into the void. kill_shape = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%).

DOCTRINE FIT (§2.0) — CRUSHER (island B, x1580..2480, center x2030): a HORIZONTAL two-head steel crusher. (1) LETHAL — the heads instakill on contact via kill(&ring_out); no impulse/hitstun, no shove. (2) TELEGRAPHY — a long OPEN DWELL (heads parked apart = the clear beat) then a windup SHUDDER + hazard-red FLASH on the closing faces for telegraph_lead 0.55s BEFORE a fast ~0.34s close (period_s 2.6). (3) FAIRNESS — the lethal band SHIFTS and never covers all of B at once: when OPEN the heads sit at B's edges (x~1550..1750 and ~2310..2510) leaving B's CENTER (x~1750..2310) a clear standing refuge; when CLOSED the heads meet at center (x~1815..2245) leaving B's LEFT (x1580..1815) and RIGHT (x2245..2480) edges clear. So a standing refuge on B ALWAYS exists (it just moves center<->edges — run with the rhythm), AND islands A and C are permanent refuges. The head band is y945..1115 (catches a standing player, body center ~1040), so boosting UP above y945 also clears a slam. No player spawns inside a head (all B spawns are at the center strip, clear at t=0 when the cycle starts OPEN). (4) CREDIT — a crusher kill with no attacker = uncredited self-fall (killer=-1, INV-9); a rival who knocked/tagged the victim within kill_credit_window_ringout=6.0s is credited by the existing ring-out window. The crusher never sets last_attacker; NO invented environment scorer.

DOCTRINE FIT (§2.0) — FALLING_DEBRIS (island C, x3160..4060): giant balls drop from above onto THREE spread columns (x3360/3610/3860) on a 1.5s cadence. (1) LETHAL — a chunk overlap instakills via kill(&ring_out); no impulse/hitstun. (2) TELEGRAPHY — a growing ground shadow + a pulsing hazard-red reticle + a drop line mark the impact column for telegraph_lead 0.75s BEFORE the chunk exists; read it, step off. (3) FAIRNESS — a steady cadence with max_concurrent 2 (never a wall of balls filling all footing at once); the three columns are ~250px apart so the gaps BETWEEN them (and islands A/B) are always safe standing spots each beat; symmetric (any player under a marked column faces it equally). Chunks despawn on landing (floor_y 1080) with a dust puff, or fall into the void. (4) CREDIT — identical to the crusher (self-fall if untagged; knocker credited via the 6s window; no environment scorer).

GEOMETRY (symmetric flagship void_is_floor, mirrors hammer_arena): three flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..900 top1080 / B x1580..2480 top1080 (CRUSHER, center x2030) / C x3160..4060 top1080 (DEBRIS zone), separated by 680px void gaps (flagship spacing; flight-required, > 527 max spring drift). Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (>= 650px recovery sky under the islands; outer edges 610px inside the side blast lines). VOID READS AS DEATH via the pit_void_rendering treatment (dark bottomless gradient + canyon walls + under-lip AO + hazard-red rim/chevrons + falling motes). Smoggy grey-brown open_sky (clouds off) = an industrial yard.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; Tuning: trampoline apex 270px, air_drift_max 340px/s => ~395px zero-boost drift; max spring drift ~527px; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- DODGE the crusher on B: shuffle with its rhythm (center-safe when open, edges-safe when closed) or boost up above the head band; a mistimed stand in the closing band = instant off-screen kill. Verb: DODGE (+ TIME).
- DODGE the debris on C: step off a marked column during its 0.75s telegraph; the gaps between the three columns are always safe. Verb: DODGE (+ READ).
- Neither hazard makes a required GAP crossing uncrossable (the crusher stays over B, the debris over C, both leaving refuges), and neither creates a bounce path across a gap: flight is REQUIRED; the hazards reshape/time the fight, they never carry you across.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the first level with a CRUSHER and FALLING DEBRIS (hammer_arena has a rotor; wrecking_yard a non-lethal pendulum shover; bumper_gauntlet static elastic reflectors). One-sentence C3 read: 'time the trash-compactor on the middle island and dodge the falling wrecking-balls on the right, while you knock rivals into them or off into the pit.' The hazards are killers AND tools; the void is the shared floor.
